raw_comment: I notice that the coastal areas on the map experience less intense droughts, while the landlocked states in the central part of the country are hit the hardest. I wonder the main cause for certain areas to be extreme drought and those nearby to be abnormally dry. This relates to me because I live in a severe drought area and it can potentially cause a wildfire. Mother Nature has no tears left to cry
